They are distinct from the inspected counters, counter allocators, compact copy and XOR controllers.

Elementary full-adder/sign-extension identities, increment arithmetic, copy, zero allocation and explicit tape machines have prior art here. Claim only these particular source/API implementations, counted transitions, exact stated endpoints and represented footprints; no first-ever or optimality claim.
The package deliberately excludes the newer explicit-marker adder ae494a28, signed alignment and paid zip builder. Their acceptance does not retroactively replace this frozen two-source boundary.

Adder clears seven scratch registers and overwrites output; padding clears one Bool scratch into blank output. Neither reconstructs arbitrary prior dirty output/scratch.
